release_notes:
Vortex PT 1.5.3 ADAPT Chair Glitch Fix, Integrated Column Header Switches & Zero-Flicker Silent Updates:
• ADAPT Chair Height Glitch Resolved: Fixed intermediate chair elevation inflation beside high points. Intermediate chairs along sagging profiles are strictly capped by adjacent peak control points. Flat/straight spans between equal high points (e.g., 200mm left and 200mm right) remain exactly collinear at 200mm without jumping to 210mm.
• ADAPT prof_type = 8 (Straight) Span Handler: Included prof_type = 8 in span processor, preventing straight spans from mistakenly evaluating as 3-point reverse parabolas.
• Integrated 2-Line Column Header with WinUI 3 Toggles: Placed authentic FluentToggleSwitch controls (blue capsule track, round thumb, On/Off label) directly beneath each column header cell in the table header, with synchronized horizontal scrolling. All columns remain visible in the app while toggles govern CAD DWG and Excel exports.
• Zero-Flashing Background Updates: Fixed FluentInfoBar widget recreation loop, eliminating all screen flashing and window flickering during automatic background update downloads.
• Theme Selector Real-Time Activation: Fixed SettingsView theme dropdown so selecting Mica, Mica Old, Acrylic, or Dark Solid updates the palette and applies immediately across all surfaces.
